name: Spanish Common Words Set 17
description: This set includes 100 common Spanish words, consisting of nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs, designed as part of a larger series of essential vocabulary flashcards.

cards.sentence: Ven acá un momento, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Come here for a moment, please.

cards.sentence: El supermercado está allá, al final de la calle.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The supermarket is over there, at the end of the street.

cards.sentence: Hace frío, es mejor ir adentro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's cold, it's better to go inside.

cards.sentence: Los niños están jugando afuera en el jardín.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children are playing outside in the garden.

cards.sentence: Me dio un saludo amistoso al llegar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He gave me a friendly greeting upon arrival.

cards.sentence: Tuvimos una triste despedida en el aeropuerto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We had a sad farewell at the airport.

cards.sentence: Mi apartamento está en el tercer piso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My apartment is on the third floor.

cards.sentence: Es el cuarto libro de la serie.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's the fourth book in the series.

cards.sentence: Ella llegó en quinto lugar en la carrera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She came in fifth place in the race.

cards.sentence: El sexto capítulo es mi favorito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The sixth chapter is my favorite.

cards.sentence: Hoy es el séptimo día del mes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Today is the seventh day of the month.

cards.sentence: Celebraron su octavo aniversario de bodas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They celebrated their eighth wedding anniversary.

cards.sentence: Fue su novena victoria consecutiva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It was their ninth consecutive victory.

cards.sentence: Terminamos el décimo problema de matemáticas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We finished the tenth math problem.

cards.sentence: Son las once de la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's eleven o'clock at night.

cards.sentence: Mi cumpleaños es el doce de diciembre.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My birthday is on December twelfth.

cards.sentence: Tiene trece años y ya es muy alto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is thirteen years old and already very tall.

cards.sentence: Hay catorce sillas alrededor de la mesa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are fourteen chairs around the table.

cards.sentence: La fiesta de quinceañera es en dos semanas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The quinceañera party is in two weeks.

cards.sentence: Necesito dieciséis tornillos para terminar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need sixteen screws to finish.

cards.sentence: Compró diecisiete manzanas en el mercado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He bought seventeen apples at the market.

cards.sentence: Mi hermano cumplió dieciocho ayer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My brother turned eighteen yesterday.

cards.sentence: El número de la casa es el diecinueve.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The house number is nineteen.

cards.sentence: La clase tiene veinte estudiantes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The class has twenty students.

cards.sentence: Tiene treinta euros en su cartera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He has thirty euros in his wallet.

cards.sentence: La temperatura es de cuarenta grados.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The temperature is forty degrees.

cards.sentence: Tenemos cincuenta minutos para el examen.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have fifty minutes for the exam.

cards.sentence: Mi abuela tiene sesenta años.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandmother is sixty years old.

cards.sentence: Faltan setenta kilómetros para llegar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are seventy kilometers left to arrive.

cards.sentence: Vendieron ochenta entradas en una hora.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They sold eighty tickets in an hour.

cards.sentence: El ángulo es de noventa grados.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The angle is ninety degrees.

cards.sentence: Ciento cincuenta personas asistieron al evento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: One hundred fifty people attended the event.

cards.sentence: El paquete pesa doscientos gramos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The package weighs two hundred grams.

cards.sentence: Un millón de gracias por tu ayuda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A million thanks for your help.

cards.sentence: La Tierra es un planeta azul.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Earth is a blue planet.

cards.sentence: Vivimos en la galaxia de la Vía Láctea.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We live in the Milky Way galaxy.

cards.sentence: El universo es vasto y misterioso.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The universe is vast and mysterious.

cards.sentence: El pueblo está situado en un hermoso valle.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The village is located in a beautiful valley.

cards.sentence: Fuimos a ver el volcán inactivo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We went to see the inactive volcano.

cards.sentence: El huracán causó muchos daños en la costa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The hurricane caused a lot of damage on the coast.

cards.sentence: Las fuertes lluvias provocaron una inundación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The heavy rains caused a flood.

cards.sentence: La región sufre una sequía severa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The region is suffering from a severe drought.

cards.sentence: Las flores florecen en primavera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Flowers bloom in spring.

cards.sentence: Pasamos el verano en la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We spent the summer at the beach.

cards.sentence: Las hojas de los árboles caen en otoño.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Tree leaves fall in autumn.

cards.sentence: El invierno es muy frío en esta zona.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Winter is very cold in this area.

cards.sentence: No olvides la fecha de entrega del proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget the project's submission date.

cards.sentence: El siglo XXI comenzó en el año 2001.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The 21st century began in the year 2001.

cards.sentence: Desde la montaña, la vista es increíble.
cards.sentenceTranslation: From the mountain, the view is incredible.

cards.sentence: Este anillo debe valer mucho dinero.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This ring must be worth a lot of money.

cards.sentence: Puedes meter la ropa en la lavadora.
cards.wordTranslation: to put in / to get into
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can put the clothes in the washing machine.

cards.sentence: Necesito ocupar este espacio en mi armario.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to occupy this space in my closet.

cards.sentence: Me encanta el sabor dulce de la miel.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love the sweet taste of honey.

cards.sentence: El café sin azúcar es muy amargo para mí.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Coffee without sugar is too bitter for me.

cards.sentence: Esta fruta tiene un sabor muy ácido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This fruit has a very sour taste.

cards.sentence: La sopa está un poco salada hoy.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The soup is a bit salty today.

cards.sentence: No me gusta la comida muy picante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't like very spicy food.

cards.sentence: Las galletas están deliciosamente crujientes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The cookies are deliciously crunchy.

cards.sentence: La superficie de la mesa es completamente lisa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The table surface is completely smooth.

cards.sentence: La piel del árbol es rugosa al tacto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The tree bark is rough to the touch.

cards.sentence: Es un objetivo digno de todo nuestro esfuerzo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's a goal worthy of all our effort.

cards.sentence: No debes tocar lo que es ajeno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You shouldn't touch what belongs to others.

cards.sentence: El petróleo bruto necesita ser refinado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Crude oil needs to be refined.

cards.sentence: El contrato es nulo si no está firmado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The contract is null if it's not signed.

cards.sentence: La casa está íntegra después del terremoto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The house is intact after the earthquake.

cards.sentence: Tiene una idea muy vaga de lo que quiere.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He has a very vague idea of what he wants.

cards.sentence: Es un amigo muy leal y confiable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is a very loyal and trustworthy friend.

cards.sentence: Mi perro es muy fiel a su dueño.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My dog is very faithful to its owner.

cards.sentence: La desaparición es muy misteriosa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The disappearance is very mysterious.

cards.sentence: Este objeto es muy valioso para la familia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This object is very valuable to the family.

cards.sentence: La tormenta causó mucho daño a los cultivos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The storm caused a lot of damage to the crops.

cards.sentence: Voy a sentar a los invitados en esta mesa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I am going to seat the guests at this table.

cards.sentence: No olvides mojar las plantas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget to water the plants (wet them).

cards.sentence: Necesito entrenar más para el maratón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to train more for the marathon.

cards.sentence: Asegúrate de sazonar bien la carne.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Make sure to season the meat well.

cards.sentence: Vamos a hornear un pastel para la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to bake a cake for the party.

cards.sentence: Prefiero freír las patatas en aceite de oliva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer to fry the potatoes in olive oil.

cards.sentence: Deja hervir el agua antes de añadir la pasta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let the water boil before adding the pasta.

cards.sentence: Puedes pelar las manzanas para el postre.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can peel the apples for dessert.

cards.sentence: Voy a congelar el resto de la sopa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm going to freeze the rest of the soup.

cards.sentence: Deja descongelar el pollo en la nevera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Let the chicken thaw in the fridge.

cards.sentence: El chocolate se va a derretir con el calor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The chocolate is going to melt with the heat.

cards.sentence: Puedes calentar la comida en el microondas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can heat the food in the microwave.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos enfriar las bebidas antes de la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need to cool the drinks before the party.

cards.sentence: Debes numerar las páginas del informe.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You must number the pages of the report.

cards.sentence: Hala la cuerda con fuerza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Pull the rope hard.

cards.sentence: Apreta el botón para encender la máquina.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Press the button to turn on the machine.

cards.sentence: No sueltes mi mano en la multitud.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't let go of my hand in the crowd.

cards.sentence: Agarra la barandilla con fuerza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Grab the handrail tightly.

cards.sentence: Puedes sostener mi bolso por un momento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Can you hold my bag for a moment?

cards.sentence: Intentó atrapar la pelota en el aire.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He tried to catch the ball in the air.

cards.sentence: Sin querer, golpeó la puerta con el codo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He accidentally hit the door with his elbow.

cards.sentence: No debes patear el balón dentro de la casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You shouldn't kick the ball inside the house.

cards.sentence: El ladrón intentó huir de la policía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The thief tried to flee from the police.

cards.sentence: Ella trató de consolar a su hermana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She tried to console her sister.

cards.sentence: Siempre intento animar a mis amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I always try to cheer up my friends.

cards.sentence: Me gusta experimentar con nuevas recetas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to experiment with new recipes.

cards.sentence: No podemos retroceder, solo avanzar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We cannot go back, only move forward.

cards.sentence: Debemos ejecutar el plan con precisión.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must execute the plan with precision.

cards.sentence: Huele a pan recién horneado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It smells like freshly baked bread.

cards.sentence: Ayúdame a desmontar los muebles.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Help me disassemble the furniture.

cards.sentence: Quiero diseñar mi propia ropa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I want to design my own clothes.

cards.sentence: Vamos a instalar el nuevo software.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to install the new software.

cards.sentence: Necesito actualizar mi currículum.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to update my resume.

cards.sentence: Pulsa este botón para activar la alarma.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Press this button to activate the alarm.

cards.sentence: No olvides desactivar la alarma antes de entrar.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Don't forget to deactivate the alarm before entering.

cards.sentence: Es hora de iniciar el proyecto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's time to start the project.
